tool_input.command:
git add internal/daemon/handler.go
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(daemon): reject Trusted classification from non-loopback IMAP hosts

beadle-hv7i: verifyTrust passed through channel.Trusted purely from a
message's own TrustLevel field. That classification is only safe when
the IMAP source is Proton Bridge on localhost -- Bridge is what
controls the X-Pm-Content-Encryption/X-Pm-Origin headers. Against a
non-local IMAP host, nothing stops a message from carrying forged
versions of those headers and being accepted as Trusted anyway.
verifyTrust now downgrades to channel.Unverified and logs a warning
when the configured IMAP host is not loopback.
EOF
)"
